title: Head of Data Strategy & Implementation in DATA ANALYTICS TRANSFORMATION - ED OFFICE
description:
**Job Description**

This is an exciting role at the heart of the Data \& Analytics Transformation (DAT) Directorate, heading up the Data Strategy Implementation Division (DSID).


It is an exciting time to work in DAT as we deliver the Bank’s Data \& Analytics (D\&A) Strategy, including moving the Bank’s data and running its analytical processes on the cloud, strengthening how we acquire and share data externally, rolling out artificial intelligence tools, and delivering a data literacy agenda for all roles. You will be joining DAT’s Leadership Team, which has a collaborative and inclusive culture, and drives change at pace for the good of the Bank as a whole.


Data Strategy Implementation Division (DSID)


Almost everything the Bank does depends on the effective use of data and analytics (D\&A). DAT’s role is to help the Bank make the best use of D\&A to fulfil its mission, which is in large part defined and delivered by the Data Strategy Implementation Division (DSID). DSID also directly enable colleagues to use data, by providing many of the central D\&A tools, platforms, services, training and specialist support.


DSID is formed of five teams:


* The **Analytics Enablement Hub (AEH)** provides the Bankwide analytics strategy. It supports colleagues realise the potential of our data and to make effective use of the analytical tools and platforms available to them.
* The **Data Management Hub (DMH)** focuses on the development, execution and governance of policies and practices to deliver, control, protect and enhance the value of the Bank’s data. It supports colleagues to better manage their data assets.
* The **Skills and Culture Hub (SCH)** has an objective to close D\&A skills gaps and to transform the Bank’s D\&A culture. It does this through upskilling, nurturing a collaborative culture, connecting users across the Bank to the services they need.
* The **Strategy Implementation Framework (SIF)** team designs and implements and a delivery framework to support teams across D\&A to more effectively deliver improved D\&A outcomes.
* The **User Centred Service Design (UCSD)** team creates and optimises user\-centric services, products, and experiences to ensure they meet the needs and expectations of users while aligning with the organisation's objectives.

The nature of the work makes DSID a home to many different skillsets, including data scientists, data governance experts, communications professionals, skills and training leads, and delivery managers. The division comprises around 50 staff and is responsible for provision of a number of Bankwide services.  



**Responsibilities**

Leadership


This is a significant leadership role. The successful applicant will be responsible for day\-to\-day leadership of the DSID senior management team and of DSID more broadly, as well as working closely with the rest of the DAT Leadership Team to run the wider directorate.


The Head of DSID line manages the senior managers of the division directly and through them around 50 staff across the division. Alongside overseeing the continued running and improvement of our central data and analytics products and services, this leadership role also includes supporting the division through a time of rapid and exciting change, requiring significant flexibility. You will develop your team through sharing information effectively, coaching, and through communicating a clear vision to ensure that DSID colleagues are engaged, effective and motivated to deliver the area's aims. This will include setting clear goals and stretching objectives that are aligned to those of the directorate and the wider Bank.


You will be part of the DAT Leadership Team (DAT LT), which collectively sets the directorate’s strategy and is responsible for its implementation. DAT LT has a focus on promoting the wellbeing of staff across DAT and ensuring the directorate a diverse, inclusive and empowering place to work. DAT HoDs are expected to lead by example, create opportunities and space for themselves and their divisions to contribute to the Bank’s inclusion agenda.


It is a particularly exciting time to be a HoD in DAT, given the Bank’s recently updated D\&A Strategy, and DSID is central to that work. The Head of DSID will need to work with DAT’s Leadership Team, with DSID colleagues and with other stakeholders to ensure that DSID continues to work effectively with the other divisions in DAT and with key stakeholders across the Bank as we implement the D\&A strategy. There are opportunities to consider how DSID works most effectively with the rest of DAT and other areas of the Bank. This may include changes to the structure and remit of DSID, which will require the successful candidate to be adaptable, flexible and able to lead others through periods of change.  



**Number of direct reports:** 5  



**Role Requirements**

Essential Criteria


* Excellent leadership skills, experience building strategic direction and developing effective teams.
* Strong expertise in shaping and leading implementation of an enterprise\-wide data and analytics strategy, leveraging industry\-standard data governance approaches, and with hands\-on experience in modern data technologies.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence business decisions to senior level, with a proven ability to handle a highly complex matrix of stakeholders.
* Extensive experience overseeing change, with proven ability to demonstrate adaptability and flexibility, and leading others through periods of change.
* Ability to collaborate with others to achieve organisation\-wide objectives, including through complex change programmes.
Experience of having implemented effective inclusion initiatives to build a diverse and resilient team.  
* 

Desirable Criteria


* Awareness of the Bank’s Data \& Analytics Strategy.
Experience of working in or with a public sector organisation to implement an ambitious data and analytics strategy.  
* 

  

\_\_\_
**Our Approach to Inclusion**

The Bank values diversity, equity and inclusion. We play a key role in maintaining monetary and financial stability, and to do that effectively, we believe we need a workforce that reflects the society we serve.


At the Bank of England, we want all colleagues to feel valued and respected, so we're working hard to build an inclusive culture which supports people from all backgrounds and communities to be at their best at work. We celebrate all forms of diversity, including (but not limited to) age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation and socioeconomic status. We believe that it’s by drawing on different perspectives and experiences that we’ll continue to make the best decisions for the public.


We welcome applications from individuals who work flexibly, including job shares and part time working patterns. We've also partnered with external organisations to support us in making adjustments for candidates and employees in the recruitment process where they're needed.


For most roles where work can be carried out at home, we aim for colleagues to spend half of their time in the office, with a minimum of 40% per month. Subject to that minimum requirement, individuals and managers should work together to find what works best for them, their team and stakeholders.


Finally, we're proud to be a member of the Disability Confident Scheme . If you wish to apply under this scheme, you should check the box in the ‘Candidate Personal Information’ under the ‘Disability Confident Scheme’ section of the application.

We are seeking to recruit a Data Science Level 6 Apprentice to join our Data Science group. Collaborating with our industry partners, we develop tools, frameworks, and applications to accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies across the UK industry and the public sector.  



**About an Apprenticeship at STFC**

We’re looking for enthusiastic and motivated individuals ready to develop their skills through formal training and hands\-on experience. You’ll be fully supported throughout the programme with regular check\-ins from a dedicated Apprenticeship Coordinator, structured training, practical experience, and mentorship from industry professionals. Plus, you’ll have access to workshops, a peer network, and career development support, helping you feel confident and prepared for new challenges.  



**Why join the Hartree Data Science group at STFC**

The Data Science groups work on data analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence projects. Data scientist

University of Nottingham: Data Scientist Degree Apprenticeship \- The University of Nottingham

Our work involves a range of industry sectors including healthcare, manufacturing, energy and agri\-tech. There is some scope for choosing projects in areas you find especially interesting. From small start \-up companies to large multinational corporations, you will work closely with commercial teams with some work being commercial in confidence.

* Learn and apply data\-centric analytics and AI technologies.
